race.title: Castle Sychrov Novices' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY has taken to chasing like a duck to water and can add a second success to his tally with further improvement on the cards. Prairie Queen finished 5 lengths behind the selection last time and she looks the biggest threat again in a reapplied tongue tie, with Monark Wood rounding off the shortlist now tackling the larger obstacles (chaser on looks). ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE) PRAIRIE QUEEN MONARK WOOD (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Onehundredneighty (6/5), Prairie Queen (13/8), Lheur De Gloire (7/1), Mavis Pike (16/1), Hans Lippershey (20/1), Monark Wood (20/1), Mystic Wind (33/1)
